description: HELD-OUT routing set 3. Labelled by retrieval need BEFORE the router was ever run on it; scored exactly once and not used to change any rule. Includes look-alikes for the rules added after sets 1 and 2 (bare before/after/since, 'part number of', capitalised names containing relation words, 'reference' and 'operators' as nouns, 'How is ... related to'). Do not edit labels after a run; add a new set instead.
